mapper.sql: r.id, r.batch_id, r.status, r.trigger_type, r.window_text, r.total_logs, r.sls_rows, r.fingerprints, r.new_count, r.surge_count, r.quiet_count, r.template_count, r.matched_count, r.unmatched_count, r.template_extracted, r.event_count, r.elapsed_ms, r.message, r.start_time, r.end_time, r.create_time

(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_inspect_run_item i WHERE i.run_id = r.id AND i.stage = 'ANALYZE') AS analyze_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_inspect_run_item i WHERE i.run_id = r.id AND i.stage = 'ANALYZE' AND i.result = 'FAIL') AS analyze_failed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_inspect_run_item i WHERE i.run_id = r.id AND i.stage = 'PUSH' AND i.result = 'SENT') AS push_sent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_inspect_run_item i WHERE i.run_id = r.id AND i.stage = 'PUSH' AND i.result = 'SKIP') AS push_skipped, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_inspect_run_item i WHERE i.run_id = r.id AND i.stage = 'EVENT' AND i.result = 'NEW') AS event_new, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_inspect_run_item i WHERE i.run_id = r.id AND i.stage = 'EVENT' AND i.result = 'ACCUMULATE') AS event_accumulated
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_inspect_run (batch_id, status, trigger_type, window_text, start_time) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{status}, #{triggerType}, #{windowText}, #{startTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_inspect_run SET status = #{status}, window_text = #{windowText}, total_logs = #{totalLogs}, sls_rows = #{slsRows}, fingerprints = #{fingerprints}, new_count = #{newCount}, surge_count = #{surgeCount}, quiet_count = #{quietCount}, template_count = #{templateCount}, matched_count = #{matchedCount}, unmatched_count = #{unmatchedCount}, template_extracted = #{templateExtracted}, event_count = #{eventCount}, elapsed_ms = #{elapsedMs}, message = #{message}, end_time = #{endTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_inspect_run SET status = 'FAILED', message = '进程重启或异常退出，本轮采集未完成', end_time = NOW() WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND start_time < #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ai_inspect_run ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT start_time FROM ai_inspect_run WHERE id > #{id} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_inspect_run WHERE start_time < #{before} LIMIT 5000
